Google Account

One authorization covers GDRIVE:, GMAIL: and GCAL:.

Click Authorize with Google. A new tab will open for Google consent; this page detects completion automatically.

Google may show an “app isn’t verified” warning. Click Advanced → Go to FujiNet to continue.

Already authorized? Calendar access was added later, so an older authorization does not include it. Authorize again to use GCAL:.

OneDrive

Click Authorize with Microsoft. A new tab will open for Microsoft consent; this page detects completion automatically.

Sign in with your Microsoft account and grant access when prompted.

SerialPort

BootSettings
APPKEYS
<%FN_APPKEY_COUNT%>
App keys are the settings that programs store on the FujiNet. They live on the SD card under /FujiNet/.
FILEMANAGER
Browse, upload, rename and delete the files on the SD card.
DEVICEPASSWORD

Set a password to protect the entire web UI. Password is stored hashed in flash (not SD). Forgotten it? Re-flash, or put a file named password at the root of the SD card containing only the new password. Empty to clear password. The file will be deleted after it's read.
